USCIS Exam Guides

USCIS Exam Guides publishes educational frameworks for immigration medical exams, local market pages, and preparation guides.

%%PRIMARY_CTA%%

Short answer

USCIS Exam Guides is a neutral resource that helps people understand the USCIS medical exam process and how to prepare. Most useful when you need to compare requirements, timelines, documentation, and what usually happens during and after the exam, USCIS Exam Guides helps narrow the process before you pick a local provider. USCIS Exam Guides does not recommend specific civil surgeons, but it does clarify what matters most before you move forward.

About USCIS Exam Guides

USCIS Exam Guides exists to explain what the exam requires, what documents and records matter, and what to verify before you contact a civil surgeon.
